name: Pixel 6
status: scaffold: sourced values filled, DRAM/userdata/USB DMA still to measure (no hardware run yet)

notes.dram_banks: GUESS, conservative: a 4 GiB subset copied from bluejay (6 GiB phone). The Pixel 6 has 8 GiB, so the real high bank is larger; a subset only under-uses RAM. MEASURE with a probe run (the shim prints the live /memory banks) before trusting it.
notes.xnu_ram: GUESS: the same hole-free 4 GiB as bluejay, a subset of what an 8 GiB phone should have. Re-derive from the measured banks (must hold no carve-out, 32 MiB aligned).
notes.userdata_mib: NOT SET: depends on the storage size (128/256 GiB). MEASURE from the GPT (ufs-gpt-read) before any check-ios-root.py run; until then no iOS root may be built for oriole.
notes.usb_dma_range: NOT SET: bluejay's abl@f8800000 window was observed in its live FDT. MEASURE oriole's reserved-memory from the probe log; XNU patch 0082 refuses USB without it.
notes.fb: Read from source: mainline gs101-oriole.dts:36-48, splash@fac00000, 1080*2400*4 = 0x9E3400, stride 4320, a8r8g8b8 (docs/research/05-fact-check.md section 3a). Not yet observed on oriole.
notes.key_pins: Read from source: mainline gs101-pixel-common.dtsi:40-63 and :799-853 is the oriole/raven common file (docs/research/05-fact-check.md section 2): power gpa10-1 (0x174D0000, bank 0xE0), vol+ gpa8-1 and vol- gpa7-3 (0x174E0000, banks 0x40/0x20), all active low. Not yet observed on oriole.
notes.touch: Read from source: Google kernel/devices/google/raviole@81506b991a5385be6c59ee27df4dda2b1379c507 (android-gs-raviole-6.1-android16) dts/gs101-oriole-touch.dtsi includes gs101/gs101-fts-touch.dtsi (the same shared file bluejay uses) and sets st,dchip_id <0x36 0x48>, st,max-coords <1079 2399>, panel samsung_s6e3fc3. Pins/USI/frequency come from the shared gs101-fts-touch.dtsi and gs101-common-touch.dtsi and are copied from bluejay; TODO(verify) that raviole does not override them before enabling touch.
